inputs.name: hand over from Model Performance Monitoring to Alerting System

output.level_0: Performance alerts trigger randomly, causing the on-call team to ignore all notifications.
output.level_1: No connection exists between monitoring and alerting, so performance issues go completely unnoticed.
output.level_2: Engineers manually check dashboards and send emails when they suspect a performance drop.
output.level_3: The system automatically sends alerts to Slack when performance metrics breach defined thresholds.
output.level_4: Alert routing follows governance policies, with full audit logs for every triggered notification.
